rank3_ruling.basis: section_4_md4_run_spec of tasks/TASK-20260821-229643/instrument-class-scope.yaml, as amended below; the ruling is recorded BEFORE dispatch per the opening decision
amendments: VERIFICATION ORACLE (new design point): the MD4 solver core is written from the filed RFC 1320 text (NOT hashlib, NOT the MD5 module path). Certificate verification uses (i) the RFC 1320 official test vectors (a gate that must pass before any search, recorded in the manifest) and (ii) a second, independent MD4 implementation as the certificate checker, written as a distinct code path from the solver core (mirror of the IMPL pin pattern); if a genuinely independent second implementation is infeasible within budget, the fallback is test vectors + structural self-check, which MUST be recorded in the manifest and flagged for the reviewers. hashlib.md4 (if available) may serve ONLY as an additional verification oracle, recorded as provenance: system-library, verification-only, never in the solver core.

EXPECTED ROW: R6 (target FAIL, variant FAIL) is the expected row. R5 only on the inverted outcome (null-object SUCCESS, target FAIL). Any full-128 SUCCESS is above R5, is the informative result, is NOT an error, but is a scope change flagged to the Coordinator at the close.

DISCRIMINATION CRITERION: the MSB-prefix quantity is read qualitatively - non-zero growth of the prefix-length distribution on the MD4 target vs no growth on the null object. TOL = 2 applies to the cost ratio R = t_null / t_target (interval [0.5, 2.0] COMPARABLE), not to the 0-baseline bit count.
rank3_ruling.run_scope: Two runs, SEQUENTIAL (target first, then null object), deterministic seed 0, N = 2^21 blocks, k = 40, 900 s wrapper deadline each (checked per block - hard stop), run_wrapped (the only acceptance path), 4 GB batch memory, hex 512-bit block encoding, identical-prefix 2-block messages per the frozen MD5 instrument strategy (bounded BIRTHDAY search - NOT meet-in-the-middle, NOT differential). Target: standard MD4 constants (shift 0). Null object: T[i] = T[(i+16) mod 48] over the 48-entry sequence (round 1 -> 0x5A827999, round 2 -> 0x6ED9EBA1, round 3 -> 0); everything else identical.
rank3_ruling.build_scope: harness/run_md4_calib.py is NEW, written by c4a158, mirroring harness/run_md5_calib.py (frozen - not modified). The 35-test suite must still pass after the build. The RFC 1320 test vectors must pass as a gate before the search.
rank3_ruling.consumption: The MD4 runs consume NO MD5 payload. The completeness check: the MD4 manifests input-hash set intersected with the MD5 quarantined payload sha256 set must be EMPTY (hash-only; the payload is never read).
